# HR Benefits and Policy Review

This document outlines key areas for urgent review and optimization within the Human Resources department concerning employee benefits and policies.

## Medical Insurance
*   Urgent optimization of medical insurance policies is required.
*   Medical insurance policies are to be updated quarterly.

## Bonus Structure
*   Ongoing monitoring of the bonus structure standard update is necessary.

## Annual Leave
*   Optimization of the annual leave policy for strategy 2026 is required.
